newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank repo average rate drops to 16.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank repo average rate drops to 16.50 pct.

text.p: The average rate at a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Thursday dropped to 16.50 percent from 16.74 percent on Tuesday, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS offered a maximum amount of 1.0 billion crowns. Overall bids totalled 2.550 billion crowns. The minimum and maximum accepted rates were both at 16.50 percent.

The NBS did not hold any repo operation on Wednesday. It added 2.0 billion crowns to the interbank market through a three-day repo tender on Tuesday, with an average rate falling to 16.74 percent from 18.82 percent on Monday.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 23 lacked 2.42 percent of the cumulative funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 31.
